top_stories.title: Security Concerns Over Russian Espionage in Europe
top_stories.summary: Latvian authorities have detained a couple suspected of spying for Russia near a NATO military base. Separately, investigations have revealed pro-Russian networks in Poland running fake student schemes to traffic cheap labor and secure Schengen visas.

top_stories.title: Abortion Pill Delivery Locker Launched in Poland
top_stories.summary: Activists in Poland have launched the world's first automated abortion pill delivery locker to circumvent restrictive local laws. This development represents a significant escalation in the ongoing debate over reproductive rights in Central Europe.

europe_now.title: French School Blockades and Budget Pressures
europe_now.summary: France faces mounting public unrest and school blockades as the government prepares a strict 2027 budget featuring new taxes and frozen wages. The unfolding fiscal measures have also intensified political friction as leaders navigate strained public finances.

europe_now.title: Latvian Espionage Arrests
europe_now.summary: Law enforcement authorities in Latvia have detained a couple suspected of conducting espionage activities for Russia. The arrests highlight ongoing regional security concerns regarding surveillance targeting national defense infrastructure.

top_stories.title: French Budget and Protests
top_stories.summary: The French government has introduced a stringent 2027 budget plan aimed at addressing strained public finances through measures like frozen wages and new taxes. Meanwhile, escalating school blockades and protests against these conditions have led to clashes with riot police and multiple arrests.

top_stories.title: Energy Reserves and Supplies
top_stories.summary: United States energy officials have urged European authorities to release a significant portion of their diesel reserves. This diplomatic push comes amid ongoing global discussions regarding energy security and market stability.
